items.title: Israel re-establishes closed West Bank settlement, defying growing international protests
items.description: Thirty "pioneer families" have arrived on a wave of nationalism driven by Israel's government, but the rapid change has left nearby Palestinian residents fearful.

items.title: UK, France, Germany, Italy and Canada condemn Israel's West Bank settlement project
items.description: European countries and Canada pile on pressure over Israel's plans to expand settlements in a strategically vital part of the occupied West Bank.

items.title: How much could Trump's 'economic D-Day' hurt Iran?
items.description: Iran has so far proved adept at finding ways around years of already punishing sanctions on its economy.

items.title: Hong Kong's Tiananmen activists guilty in national security trial
items.description: Three activists were accused of inciting others to subvert state power under the China-introduced law.

items.title: Five missing after fire in Swiss Alpine town
items.description: Eight others were injured, local police say, with the cause of the fire still being investigated.

items.title: Bali jails Swiss tourist for insulting sacred Day of Silence
items.description: The 26-year-old was jailed for a year after he sparked anger with an expletive-laden post about the sacred holiday.

items.title: Panama Canal to cut number of ships passing through due to El Niño
items.description: The crucial waterway's operator says low rainfall caused by the ocean pattern had led to the decision.

items.title: British rapper Yung Filly to face retrial on rape charges in Australia
items.description: A jury last month cleared the YouTuber of several sexual assault offences, but it couldn't reach a decision on three others,

items.title: Japan executes man who killed five in Pachinko parlour fire
items.description: This is the first time since June 2025 that the country has enacted capital punishment.

items.title: Como mayor hit by electric bike and issues blanket ban in Italian city
items.description: Alessandro Rapinese said the prohibition was for public safety, adding "I know what it's like to be hit by one of these beasts".

items.title: Trump wants to be friends with Kim - but South Korea could pay the price
items.description: US military exercises with South Korea end early on Friday, at a time when the North is in a position of strength.

items.title: Pakistan ex-PM Imran Khan back in jail after hospital examination
items.description: It comes as the court had earlier this week ordered that he had to be taken for a hospital examination.
